projects.subtitle: Doctor Appointment System

Integrated secure JWT authentication, Stripe payment gateway, email notifications, appointment scheduling, and role-based dashboards to deliver a seamless healthcare management experience.

projects.title: Sports Venue Booking & Social Platform
projects.subtitle: Sports Community & Venue Booking System
projects.description: Developed a full-stack sports social platform that enables users to discover sports venues, book slots, join games, connect with other players, and share posts within the community. The platform includes secure JWT authentication, Razorpay payment integration, venue management, analytics dashboards, Cloudinary image uploads, email notifications, and a scalable RESTful API built with Node.js, Express.js, and MySQL.
